title: py-tray-command-launcher commands.json
description: Schema for the commands.json configuration file

command.description: Shell command to execute. Safe scheduling: scheduled command payloads are validated by ScheduleCreator.validate_command; shell control operators (; & | $ ` ( ) { } < > * ? ! \ and newlines/CR) are rejected and the payload is not shell-quoted, so it runs as a normal argv command. See docs/configuration.md#safe-scheduling.

showOutput.description: Show command output in a window

icon.description: Icon path (relative, absolute, https://, or data:image base64)

prompt.description: Prompt label for a user input value substituted as {promptInput}
